description: Local businesses from a Maps search — name, address, phone, website, rating, hours, place id. Flat 2 credits. No emails. Costs 2 credits. Empty results and failures are never charged. Pass cache=true for a free 24h cache hit (default always fresh).

cache.description: Set true to serve from the 24h response cache (0 credits on hit). Default false — always fetch fresh.

language.description: Language code, for example en. Default en.

limit.description: Max businesses to return (default 20, max 100). Not a page cursor — there is no next page. Flat 2 credits per call; zero businesses is 0 credits.

location.description: Place name: City, Country or City, Region, Country — for example Austin, TX, Istanbul, Turkey, Paris, France, or a country such as Germany. Case, accents, US state codes, and country aliases (USA, UK, Turkey) are handled. A city name shared by several places (Paris) returns 400 with suggestions. When set, the locationCode parameter is ignored.

locationCode.description: Numeric place code, used only when location is omitted. Default 2840 (United States).

q.description: Keyword, for example plumber or coffee. Min 2 characters.

name: google_maps_business_search
title: Google Maps Business Search
